title: agentseam recorded driver: a frozen witness run
description: One file per (agent, version) -- data/recordings/<agent>@<version>.json -- written by
tools/experiment.py --record from a real agent, never by hand and never edited after
landing: a newer version is a new file, not a rewrite of this one (owner decision
replays it through the same tools/experiment.py classifier a live run would have used,
so `--driver recorded` reproduces the witnessed table without launching a process.
Facts only: `notes` is the one line of prose this file allows.

driver.description: Always real-agent: the same invariant evidence_report.py enforces on a submitted report -- only a running agent may freeze a witness recording.

notes.description: One line. The why belongs in the PR body, not here.

events.description: Canonical event name -> what was witnessed there. A key present here IS the claim 'this gate was measured'; a gate this agent claims but this file omits was simply not run yet -- that is the partial-recording case, not an error.

payload_keys.description: Every payload key seen across this event's trials, sorted and deduplicated -- the wire shape at this gate, not a per-trial value.

trials.description: Trial name (tools/experiment_probe.py's BEHAVIOURS, plus escalate when run) -> the sentinel and invocation counts witnessed. Not the classified outcome itself: replaying these through experiment._classify is what keeps a recording's semantics identical to a live run's, rather than merely similar.

hook_invocations.description: How many times the hook fired for this trial. At the stop gate this is the re-fire count, capped by the harness's own max_continuations -- not a raw wall-clock count.
